name: 215W Custom N-Type 16BB Bifacial Solar Module
tagline: Anti-Shading 215W with 4-Zone Independent Design. Built on N-Type 16BB TOPCon cell technology with a unique 4-zone independent circuit layout, the CN215W keeps Vmp rock-solid even under partial shade—retaining 75% more power when obstructed. Up to 30% bifacial rear-side gain, IP68 protection and 25-year linear power warranty.
tech: N-Type 16BB monocrystalline silicon · SMBB super multi-busbar · Quarter-cell technology · 4 independent power zones with multi-bypass diodes · Bifacial transparent backsheet
imageAlt: Callsun CN215W N-Type 16BB bifacial solar module front and back view on white background with junction box and MC4 connectors
description: Callsun CN215W is a 215W custom N-Type 16BB bifacial solar module engineered for B2B distributors, RV manufacturers, marine dealers, portable power station brands and off-grid system integrators who need a compact, anti-shading module for 12V battery systems and major portable power stations. The 4-zone independent design with multi-bypass diodes keeps power output uninterrupted when partial shade hits the panel, and IP68 + 5400Pa mechanical load rating handles all-terrain all-weather conditions.

benefits.title: N-Type 16BB TOPCon Technology
benefits.description: Built on advanced N-Type architecture with Callsun's in-house TOPCon cell technology and 16BB super multi-busbar layout, the CN215W delivers conversion efficiency of over 25%, superior low-light performance, and exceptional long-term stability.

benefits.title: Optimized Bifacial Gain
benefits.description: The dual-glass N-Type design maximizes bifaciality, capturing up to 30% extra bonus energy from the backside—grass 7.21%, cement 9.54%, sand 9.84%, snow 14.83%, mirror 24.85%—to significantly boost your daily and lifetime yield.

benefits.title: Anti-Shading 4-Zone Design
benefits.description: Featuring 4 independent power zones with multiple bypass diodes, the module keeps Vmp stable even under partial shade from trees, masts or ridges—retaining 75% more power, eliminating MPPT restarts and reducing hot-spot stress.

benefits.title: Low Temperature Coefficient
benefits.description: Engineered with a best-in-class -0.30%/K temperature coefficient, the CN215W minimizes power degradation in intense heat, ensuring stable and consistent performance across desert, marine and high-temperature environments.

benefits.title: Protected Against Extreme Environments
benefits.description: IP68-rated junction box, 3.2mm tempered glass and anodized aluminum frame deliver all-weather durability—certified to withstand marine salt spray, intense humidity, heavy rain, high winds, hailstorms and packed snow with 2400Pa wind load and 5400Pa snow load.

benefits.title: Industry-Leading Warranty
benefits.description: Backed by a comprehensive 12-year product quality warranty and a 25-year linear power warranty (84.5% output at year 25; 1% first-year + 0.4%/year linear), ensuring long-term reliability and secure energy returns.
